I'll pull the factory defaults from the settings table, then trace the real exit paths before changing the hook.The registration table’s factory bytes for these cells are zeros, and the overlay’s section check matches the inherited three call-site bytes. Next I’ll trace the editor’s exit paths.The direct screen leaves through the GUI state log: OK, MENU, S1, and playback each move off `0x0405`. The custom-size editor was not on that path in this trace, because playback had already stopped on a warning. I'll measure that editor's state changes on their own.The custom-size editor never leaves menu state `0x0b02`. Its OK is the event `0x900d` after a Right (`0x900b`), and the direct screen leaves when the state log moves off `0x0405`. The exit hook will use those.OK, MENU, and half-press each leave through the state log, and the custom-size OK does too: the setter wrote C1 into the mirror before event `0x900d` cleared the flag. The comparison missed those bytes because the mirror fields were named in decimal. Playback and session end are next.Playback clears the flag and restores the zone byte, then the body stays on the no-picture warning, so the later sessions never started. The six experiment versions are used. I'll write the record of what was proven.The acceptance run did not reach `ok:true`. Six experiment versions were used on the exit hook, and the script stopped after playback, before initialization, the save, or the orientations.

What the hook does: on every exit that did run, the hook itself clears `0xa031eef7` and puts the zone byte `0xa031e920` back to the value it held when the flag became 1. In these sessions that value is 0, the Z5 image byte. A normal edit never writes the zone byte, so K2 still holds 0, and restoring that snapshot is why the next dial matches. The AF-ON selection stays in the mirror.

| Exit | Result |
| --- | --- |
| OK, MENU, S1 | Flag cleared, zone byte restored to 0, and the following edit matches K1 and K2 |
| Custom size C1 and C2 | The OK writes the mirror only (`0x1dd1` indices 2–3 for C1, 4–5 for C2, plus the `0x1df1` anchor). The same OK with the flag off writes those bytes into K1's half-press cells |
| Playback | The hook clears the flag and restores the zone byte, then the body stays on the no-picture warning (`0x0105`). Playback, OK, MENU, and S1 do not leave it, so the following edit has no shooting screen to start from |
| Session end | Not run |

The factory defaults are the registration payloads, and they are zeros, including zone type 0 (All). That list is in `work/out/profile-layout.md`. The initialization that would write those zeros into an `FF` mirror is in `exit_l6.mjs` and was never enabled, because playback stopped the run first.

The entry remains the session flag at `0xa031eef7`. No menu row was added. Q5 stays with the coordinator. No storage decision and no hardware recommendation.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. Command 14, which built the manifest, is sealed in `work/evidence-supplement.json`.The stock trace finished successfully. On the direct screen, OK, MENU, the shutter half-press, and playback each leave state `0x0405`. The custom-size editor does not: it stays on the menu, and its OK is a self-transition of `0x0b02`.

Playback ends on the no-picture warning, so the size-editor steps that followed it in that trace are not usable. Those transitions are what the exit hook was built from, and they are already recorded in `work/result.md`.
